title: TagGroup
lead: A TagGroup is a container for multiple controls that are Tag or InteractionTag.

examples.name: Dismiss
examples.description: A TagGroup contains a collection of Tag/InteractionTag that can be dismissed. Ensure that focus is properly managed when all tags have been dismissed.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: A TagGroup can set default size for all its tags. It supports `medium`, `small` and `extra-small` size. Default value is `medium`.

examples.name: With Overflow
examples.description: A TagGroup can support overflow by using Overflow and OverflowItem.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: A TagGroup can be disabled. The collection of Tag/InteractionTag will also be disabled.

examples.name: Select
examples.description: A TagGroup contains a collection of InteractionTag that can be selected. Note: This prop only changes the appearance of the tag at the moment. A future PR will add the integration with TagGroup.

prose.text:
## Best practices

### Do

- A Picker component is planned for displaying multiple selected values using `TagGroup` with `Combobox`, and will be the recommended approach once it's available. But for now, when using `TagGroup` with `Combobox`:

  - Set the `listbox` role for `TagGroup` and the `option` role for each `Tag`.
  - If using `InteractionTag`, set the `option` role for the content and make the dismiss button not focusable. When content is focused, Enter/Space should invoke the primary action, and Backspace/Delete remove the tag.

- When using `TagGroup` with non-actionable `Tag` (i.e. `Tag` without dismiss icon), set the `list` role for `TagGroup` and the `listitem` role for each `Tag`.

api.reason: 공식 문서에 정리된 표가 없어서, 설치된 패키지에 들어 있는 타입 정의에서 뽑았어요 (ADR-025). 이 컴포넌트가 물려받는 속성까지 함께 담았습니다. 설명과 기본값은 그 타입 정의에 달린 주석에서 가져온 것이라 공식 문서의 표현과 다를 수 있고, 기본값이 주석에 안 적힌 속성은 기본값 칸이 비어 있어요 — 기본값이 없다는 뜻은 아닙니다. 타입 정의에 없는 것(문서에만 있거나 실행 중에만 받는 값)은 여기 없어요.
